responsibility: Declares the M2LINK interface that exposes the runtime linkage configuration variables controlling how GNU Modula-2 modules are initialized and, optionally, the caller-specified module initialization order. It serves as the public contract for the boot runtime’s link/initialization-mode state by defining the exported flag and forced-order string types and declarations that other startup and dependency-management code can inspect.
same_name_distinction: This is the interface/header side of GM2LINK: it defines the public types and `extern` declarations for the linkage-control globals so other boot-runtime files can include and inspect them. Unlike `GM2LINK.cc`, it does not allocate or initialize the variables; it only describes the contract for the single definitions provided there.
